findings: Exact diagnostic delta adds one transfer helper; every prior diagnostic AST definition is unchanged. Transport adds only its import and guarded invocation after creating the replacement generic wrapper.

Original and existing target diagnostic states pass the existing closed validator: at most16 finite secondary rows, bounded omission count, no arbitrary fields. Only cloned secondary rows and saturated omission count are transferred.
Existing target primary location/persistence/printed fields are preserved; absent target receives UNKNOWN/IN_MEMORY_ONLY defaults. Original location, durable and printed claims are not copied.

Rows and omission count are constructed before one setattr; same-object input returns false. Invalid state or setter/transfer BaseException returns false and cannot replace the primary. Transport additionally guards the transfer invocation itself.
Terminal/outcome, request checks, budget/reservation, native semantics and finalizer order are unchanged. No new imports beyond the independently reviewed diagnostic helper.
required_actual_controls: Four prior transport/product/cleanup cases after repaired pinned package-resource loading.

CONNECT OSError plus first exit-callback RuntimeError retains original CONNECT/OSError, UNKNOWN, terminal=false, dispatch=false, no request/getresponse and persisted secondary plus mandatory finalizers.
Bounded merge/omission preservation and malformed-state refusal within the same finite control fixture.
